id: \bBugs can survive for a long time. They evolve quickly too.
en: \bBugs can survive for a long time. They evolve quickly too.
it: \bGli insetti possono sopravvivere a lungo. E si evolvono anche in fretta.

id: \bBurgh uses Bug type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Fire, Flying, and Rock types.
en: \bBurgh uses Bug type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Fire, Flying, and Rock types.
it: \bArtemisio usa Pokémon di tipo Coleottero. Sono deboli contro i tipi Fuoco, Volante e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Psychic, Grass, and Dark. Fighting, Grass, and Ground also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Psychic, Grass, and Dark.  Fighting, Grass, and Ground also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Psico, Erba e Buio. Anche Lotta, Erba e Terra non fanno molti danni.

id: \bBurgh: I see you've made it to my gym.
en: \bBurgh: I see you've made it to my gym.
it: \bArtemisio: Vedo che sei arrivato alla mia Palestra.

id: \bLet's begin this elegant battle. I'm hoping this can inspire me down the road.
en: \bLet's begin this elegant battle. I'm hoping this can inspire me down the road.
it: \bCominciamo questa lotta elegante. Spero che possa ispirarmi in futuro.
\bArtemisio: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Insetto.

id: \bTM76 contains Pollen Puff. It damages an opposing Pokémon or restores a health of an ally.
en: \bTM76 contains Pollen Puff. It damages an opposing Pokémon or restores a health of an ally.
it: \bLa MT76 contiene Sferapolline. Danneggia un Pokémon avversario o ripristina i PS di un alleato.

id: \bBurgh: I hope you enjoy the city. Don't forget to explore the nature around you though.
en: \bBurgh: I hope you enjoy the city. Don't forget to explore the nature around you though.
it: \bArtemisio: Spero che la città ti piaccia. Ma non dimenticarti di esplorare la natura che ti circonda.
\bArtemisio non perderà mai contro di te.

id: \bBurgh is ten times tougher than me.
en: \bBurgh is ten times tougher than me.
it: \bArtemisio è dieci volte più forte di me.

id: \bLike in a hive, you can easily get lost here.
en: \bLike in a hive, you can easily get lost here.
it: \bCome in un alveare, qui ci si perde facilmente.

id: \bI stay up front so I don't get lost.
en: \bI stay up front so I don't get lost.
